author: pep-m-classes-objects-edu-review (independent education critic; recorded by pep-m-java-foundations-classes-and-objects (Claude Opus 5.5, artifact author))

findings.claim: The recap is visible from page load beside the current activity, so it states the rules that answer the Guess prediction and the graded Apply check before the learner attempts them.
findings.recommendation: Hide the recap while JavaScript runs until every activity has settled; keep it in no-JavaScript and print readings.

findings.claim: Restart never recomputes page completion, so a restarted and then failed activity leaves data-pep-complete=true and a stale "Topic complete." banner.
findings.recommendation: Recompute page completion and route settlement after Restart and refresh the banner.

findings.claim: In every GIFT item the correct option is listed first, and in 28 of 54 items it is also the single longest option.
findings.recommendation: Balance option lengths and vary authored order unless platform shuffling is confirmed.

findings.claim: Restart on a settled code activity restores the starter, so a learner who fixed the code in practice must retype it to earn credit.
findings.recommendation: Keep the last edit on Restart or say so in the settled message.

findings.claim: The structure reader accepts a malformed field initializer such as int x = ; and counts it as a checked try.
findings.recommendation: Report the malformed shape as a problem that is not a try.

findings.claim: The Activity 2 lane labelled Class also receives a field and the type word, which blurs a class with a part of a class.
findings.recommendation: Rename the lane, for example Class (blueprint or type).

findings.claim: Modeled worst paths sit close to the 15 minute ceiling and need observed timing data.
